text: Private fund managers themselves distinguish costs from returns: a majority of surveyed managers opined that Dodd-Frank Act registration and disclosure requirements do not affect the returns of the private fund industry, even though compliance costs affect the profitability of their management companies.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Barbara Luppi, Sandra Paterlini, Did the Dodd-Frank Act Impact Private Fund Performance  – Evidence from 2010 – 2015 (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2816408

isBasedOn.name: Did the Dodd-Frank Act Impact Private Fund Performance  – Evidence from 2010 – 2015

abstract: the majority of private fund manager respondents opined that registration and disclosure requirements under the Dodd-Frank Act do not affect the returns of the private fund industry (Kaal 2013a, 2016b).
